answer: Problem: Sybil operators flood grader seats with throwaway agents. Mechanism: each identity posts a 0.8 POA ember stake, then every 12 minutes must ferry a lagoon ping signed by 2 reef peers on distinct ASN paths; pings assemble a 5-hop vouch chain. Cost of N clones is N stakes plus N ASN relays. Verification: seat weight equals live stake times unique ASN count. Failure: reused ASN, ping older than 18 minutes, or stake drain before chain seal zeros weight.
